agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance and bounded contextual implications

analytical_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
general_et_finding: Candidate design application: provisional bounded BREAKTHROUGH; dissolution not established; all six NOT SCORED. Model-directed action and earlier automation must be compared. No supported Potential or Confirmed label; no two-tier dissolution established. Component-only inputs stop at NOT YET EVALUABLE.
application_finding: The proposed chart-review assistant is prospective incremental workflow assistance relative to manual reconciliation and deterministic checks. No implemented benefit, quality advantage, savings or staffing displacement is established. Drafting and tool choice do not remove responsibility for source-grounded interpretation. Benchmark changes are not a tenfold verified chart-review result. A simpler comparator can be useful without any Promethean claim; only an actual matched comparison can establish local value.
organization_specific_finding: Finance implication: significance weight is low for immediate action. Sensitive reporting and an unapproved external-model environment remain binding. Any authorized evidence exercise stays within public or synthetic material, with a named analyst responsible for release. Compare correctly completed work, total review/correction time and full cost against existing checks. The incremental counterfactual supports a reversible comparison, not production approval, autonomous publication, staff cuts or long lock-in. Adoption and Organizational Readiness must resolve action timing and permission.

evidence.claim: Apply the sequential course instrument and distinguish facts, case premises and interpretation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Chapter 11 sections 11.2 and 11.7; S1-S6 evidence/source_register.json
evidence.evidence_type: Course framework plus bounded original-source packet
evidence.notes: No source establishes chart-review outcomes. Candidate views are supplied analyses, not independent verification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Strongest higher-significance case: scalable delegation could lower expertise barriers and enable dependent applications. Mechanism-level promise is not observed multi-tier dissolution. The strongest lower case is continued reliance on skilled humans and older automation; withholding breakthrough remains a preserved alternative.

The input is a teaching scenario. Same-assistant prompt applications and reused invariant passages are qualitative fixtures, not blinded trials or evidence of reliable deployment. Dated benchmark and human-assistance studies have different units.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a narrowly qualified capability interpretation; low confidence in long-range classification and unknown local net benefit. Withhold even breakthrough where comparator evidence cannot support it. Confidence in preserving the significance/adoption boundary is higher than confidence in empirical performance.
value_opportunity_implication: Less routine work could create value if correctly completed work improves after integration, supervision and correction costs. No benefit is measured here. A locally incremental improvement may be worth comparing without a civilizational label.
risk_governance_implication: Overstatement could bypass data permission or accountable release; dismissing capability change could also delay useful learning. These are prospective risks, not observed losses. Preserve reversible work and named human ownership.
recommendation_management_implication: New same-assistant comparison under a harmonized case, not an independent model trial or original candidate run. Compare design implications qualitatively; preserve limitations and do not infer a measured winner.
change_monitoring_triggers: Analytics owner at the proposed four-week review: compare correctness, total time and cost with manual/deterministic checks. Measured superiority strengthens the local case; no improvement weakens it.

Research owner at the twelve-month review or material new evidence: examine attributable dependence and distinct human-life tiers. Credible dissolution strengthens the higher hypothesis; concentrated, reversible uses weaken it.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request a usable system, explicit comparator and attributable dependence where absent. Unknown is not contradicted; no forced numerical score.
These saved examples illustrate the analytical design; file validation is not independent evidence of model reliability or operational readiness.
